scalability_blockers: One process inspected the public Python symbols of one installed CUDA-Q on each host. No workload was distributed and no scaling was attempted.
source_revision_note: The runtime images carry no git binary, so source_identity.commit is null on both hosts. The link from payload to source is runner_sha256, read back inside each container.

methodology.note: The survey records which gradient strategies a release exposes and whether it can return a value and a full reverse-mode gradient in one call. It is a statement about one installed release's public surface, not a timing and not a capability of FlagQuantum.
